candidates.name: Cytomegalovirus colitis
support_spans: Multiple episodes of bright red blood per rectum
Flexible sigmoidoscopy showed multiple, punched-out, irregular, nonbleeding ulcers in the rectum

candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and histopathology results suggest a diagnosis of CMV colitis, which is a common cause of rectal bleeding and ulcers in immunocompromised patients.
